lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping signed a joint peace declaration at APEC in China, a historic first for the three nations’ heads of state, Fox News reports.
‘We haven’t given them any money yet’: Ontario officials hoping for good meeting with Stellantis, CP24 reports.

The artificial intelligence giant Anthropic opened for trading Thursday in the biggest public stock offering ever, despite investor fears of a possible AI bubble and public anxiety that the technology threatens lives and livelihoo, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
